chapter.thaumory.aether_silver.text: Steep Arcane Iron again, deep in Aer and Lux, and it pales into Aether Silver. It holds more of a circle's effect than Arcane Iron can.
chapter.thaumory.arcane_metals.text: Iron steeped in Arcanum turns into Arcane Iron. Tools and armor forged from it are no stronger than iron, but they have room to take in a circle's effect.
chapter.thaumory.aspects.text: Look at a few things that share an aspect and its name comes clear. What is still nameless is written in unreadable glyphs.
chapter.thaumory.beginning.text: Everything is made of aspects. Peer at the things around you through the Arcane Loupe and their makeup slowly shows itself. What you see is written into this book.
chapter.thaumory.circles.text: Set two runes in a Core, and a third if you wish, then ring it with chalk lines. Touch it with the wand and the circle answers, if the combination is right.
chapter.thaumory.crucible.text: A cauldron fitted with gold becomes a crucible. Fill it with water and light a fire beneath, and what you throw in melts into Essentia. What overflows, and what opposing aspects wear away, becomes Flux.
chapter.thaumory.flux.text: A circle that fails to answer, or one that runs wild, spills Flux. Flux stagnates in the land, eats it away, and at last takes shape. There are said to be ways to clear it.
chapter.thaumory.inquiry.text: One who knows twelve aspects begins to hear what their combinations whisper.
chapter.thaumory.monocle.text: Steep a loupe deep in Lux and Arcanum, and it will stay at your eye. Worn on the head, it shows the Flux and what vessels, pipes and circles hold, without a hand to hold it. To name other things or to scan, you still need the loupe itself.
chapter.thaumory.runes.text: Stone steeped in Arcanum and Aqua becomes a blank rune; pour a jar's Essentia into it and it becomes that aspect's key. Clay steeped the same way gives chalk to draw circles with.
codex.thaumory.flux_warning.erosion: Flux is eating away at the land here
codex.thaumory.flux_warning.overload: Flux overflows here; circles may burst
codex.thaumory.flux_warning.stagnation: The air here is stagnant with Flux

hint.thaumory.attraction: Tempestas and Vinculum reel in what has fallen.
hint.thaumory.binding: Umbra woven into Vinculum weighs down every step.
hint.thaumory.breath: Where Aqua holds Aer, there is breath beneath the waves.
hint.thaumory.breeding: Bestia and Vita bring the beasts together.
hint.thaumory.charging: Arcanum, held by Vinculum, fills a vessel.
hint.thaumory.growth: Herba and Vita hurry the sprouting.
hint.thaumory.harvest: Where Herba meets Mors, what has ripened is reaped.
hint.thaumory.light: Where Lux lies over Ignis, darkness gives way.
hint.thaumory.lightness: Aer lifts what Terra would pull down; the step grows light.
hint.thaumory.lure: Vinculum cast over Bestia draws the beast into the chalk.
hint.thaumory.melting: Ignis and Chaos unmake things into their aspects.
hint.thaumory.mining: Bellum and Terra break open the ground beneath.
hint.thaumory.moisture: Aqua and Herba soak the furrows and quench the flame.
hint.thaumory.night_sight: Lux kept within Umbra opens the eye in the dark.
hint.thaumory.purification: Ordo and Lux clear what has stagnated.
hint.thaumory.safeguard: Ordo holds Terra fast against blast and claw.
hint.thaumory.searing: Bellum kindled with Ignis sears whatever stands against you.
hint.thaumory.smelting: Ignis over Metallum works like a forge.
hint.thaumory.sorting: Ordo steers Tempestas; what is scattered finds its place.
hint.thaumory.teleport: Arcanum, bound with Aer, bends space.
hint.thaumory.ward: Vinculum and Ordo draw a border.
hint.thaumory.weather: Tempestas and Arcanum call the sky.
hint.thaumory.withering: Mors steeped in Venenum wastes the living and the dead alike.
